commentary: With market breadth registering a subdued 44 and our deterministic gate flagging WEAK, O'Neil and Weinstein disciplines demand defensive capital allocation. Although the Nifty reclaimed 25,000, broad market participation remains fractured. Weinstein warns against aggressive long exposure when the market lacks broad Stage 2 participation; distribution days and post-earnings divergence demand strict selectivity. Under SEPA and CANSLIM tenets, progressive exposure dictates keeping position sizes modest until breadth expands. Only textbook setups backed by authentic earnings acceleration and massive institutional accumulation warrant attention, while lagging, decelerating, or low-quality names must be avoided. Capital preservation remains the supreme priority until market direction delivers an unequivocal follow-through confirmation.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM & Weinstein Stage Analysis

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Constructing a double bottom base testing the 114.91 neckline above its 50-day and 200-day moving averages on 1.49x volume. However, relative strength lags the broader market, and lack of explosive volume dry-up keeps base quality suspect.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Low operating margin of 1.5% and feeble ROE of 2.64% highlight weak pricing power. Persistent audit flags regarding inventory balances and large tax disputes stifle institutional interest, failing CANSLIM fundamental quality.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Break below the 104.11 pivot support aborts the double bottom; cut losses immediately to protect capital against illiquid downside drift.

AARON.technical: Cleared a 20-day high at 148.04 on 1.21x volume, maintaining alignment above the rising EMA21, SMA50, and SMA200. MACD resides firmly above zero, exhibiting healthy Stage 2 base breakout characteristics.
AARON.fundamental: Operating profit margins hold near 20% with strong ROCE of 18.7% and ROE of 15%. Elevator component demand drives consistent top-line expansion with zero promoter pledging and moderate leverage.
AARON.risk: Close beneath the 134.59 swing low violates structural support; enforce an immediate Minervini stop to prevent deep drawdowns.

AARTIDRUGS.technical: Staged a powerful SEPA breakout clearing 497.45 on massive 23.57x average volume. The stock trades decisively above rising 21, 50, and 200-day moving averages, confirming institutional accumulation and high relative strength.
AARTIDRUGS.fundamental: EBITDA margins expanded 370 bps to 16.6% on strong API export realisations. ROCE stands at healthy double digits, and aggressive capacity additions in Tarapur reinforce classic CANSLIM earnings power.
AARTIDRUGS.risk: Failure below the 441.76 breakout pivot invalidates the accumulation thesis; execute an immediate stop to limit portfolio risk.

ABCAPITAL.technical: Executed a clean 20-day breakout past 416.87 above upward trending 50-day and 200-day moving averages. Momentum is robust with RSI at 72 and positive MACD confirmation, though nearing near-term extension.
ABCAPITAL.fundamental: Robust 32% revenue expansion and 41% profit growth driven by strong NBFC and housing finance lending books. Solid operating leverage and rising institutional sponsorship fit CANSLIM criteria well.
ABCAPITAL.risk: A break below 391.92 invalidates the breakout structure; cut losses without hesitation to guard against sharp momentum mean-reversion.

ABDL.technical: Carving a double bottom pattern, holding support at the rising 21-EMA near recent highs with RSI at 59. Price is testing the 767.67 trigger, but volume lacks definitive institutional thrust.
ABDL.fundamental: India's second-largest distiller gains from premiumization and backward integration, but quarterly net profit growth slowed to 9.7%, falling short of CANSLIM's 25% quarterly earnings acceleration standard.
ABDL.risk: Slicing below the 712.35 reaction low breaks key moving average support; exit promptly to limit drawdown.

ABSLBANETF.technical: Surpassed 20-day high at 60.76 on 1.44x volume, moving above key moving averages in tandem with the banking index rebound. Momentum remains constructive but tethered to sector-wide follow-through.
ABSLBANETF.fundamental: Exchange traded fund tracking the Nifty Bank index; standalone corporate earnings, revenue growth, and debt ratios are not applicable to the pooled underlying banking basket.
ABSLBANETF.risk: Violation of 58.68 signals banking sector breakdown; exit position decisively in accordance with Minervini index risk discipline.
